title: Turn on the merge queue for main
goal: A PR reaches main only after its combination with the queue passes
acceptance: The owner chooses: move the repository to an organization and turn on the queue, or option 2 (push trigger on main), or option 1 (strict)
The chosen mechanism is in place and a PR shows the run it implies
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: ci.yml is a harness file: decide project-only or template first (AGENTS.md, "Changing a harness file")
Branch protection is changed by the owner

effort.basis: Split 2026-11-13 into one-actor steps (harness 8.10.0); hours unchanged in total.
